conviction_note: The two genuine 2026 earnings prints were -44.0% (Q1, 2026-06-25) and -24.4% (FY25, 2026-04-20), so the baseline's 6.52% median understates this name's earnings reaction by ~4x; against that, revenue and cash for Q2 were already pre-announced on 2026-07-23, which caps the downside relative to Q1 -- but an unquantified 'comprehensive impairment across all assets' sits against $88.0m of impairable intangibles+PP&E on a $68m market cap, and the 5-analyst consensus is still $5.49m against the company's own $4.0-4.1m, so the Sept 9 wire copy is a mechanical 26% revenue miss and a multiple-of-consensus EPS miss into a +7.5% five-day bounce.

findings.finding: Sell-side consensus for Q2 2026 is still $5.49m revenue (5 analysts, expecting +27.4% sequential growth) and -$0.16 EPS, six weeks after Nanox itself pre-announced Q2 revenue of 'approximately $4.0 to $4.1 million' -- a sequential decline; the headline on 2026-09-09 is therefore a mechanically guaranteed ~26% revenue miss.
findings.why_not_priced: If the aggregator layer had ingested the 2026-07-23 pre-announcement, the Q2 consensus would sit at $4.0-4.1m and no 'miss' headline could be generated. It does not: FXEmpire still models +27.4% sequential revenue growth, and stockanalysis.com's statistics page still shows 69.60 million shares outstanding as of 2026-09-08 (the pre-August-offering count; the actual count is 78,588,638 per the Aug 7 424B5) and a $5.13 average price target on an $0.87 stock. The pre-announcement 6-K was accepted at 17:30 ET on a Thursday and the release was never carried by StockTitan's NNOX news list. On a $68m retail-dominated name with no option chain, the Zacks/Benzinga-style 'missed by 26%' print at 08:00 ET is the marginal information for most of the tape.
findings.independence: stockanalysis.com's forecast page independently shows FY2026 consensus revenue of $25.89m from 3 analysts, against H1 2026 actual of roughly $8.4m ($4.311m Q1 + $4.0-4.1m preliminary Q2) with annual guidance formally withdrawn -- the same staleness in a second dataset: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nnox/forecast/

findings.finding: Nanox has an unquantified 'comprehensive impairment assessment across all of its assets, including but not limited to long-lived assets and goodwill' still incomplete as of 2026-08-06, sitting against $57.364m of net intangibles and $30.551m of net PP&E at 2026-03-31 -- $88.0m of impairable carrying value versus a ~$68m market cap -- and it lands in the first quarter reported by a CFO who started 2026-08-01.
findings.why_not_priced: The impairment language appears only in the body text of the Form 6-K cover and the accompanying 424B5 prospectus supplement -- the Exhibit 99.1 press release that actually went to the wire on 2026-08-06 does not mention it at all, and no analyst note or wire story quantifies it. If it were priced, the stock would not be trading at 0.48x the post-offering book value implied by the 2026-03-31 equity of $126.308m while simultaneously bouncing +7.5% in five sessions into the print. Q1's $14.265m net loss becomes a $50-90m net loss headline (roughly -$0.7 to -$1.2 per share against a -$0.16 consensus) if a material share of that $88.0m is written down, which on this shareholder base is a shock even though it is non-cash.
findings.independence: The $57.364m intangibles / $30.551m PP&E / $126.308m equity balances come from a different document, the Q1 press release of 2026-06-25 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795251/000121390026071765/ea029511001ex99-1.htm); the CFO transition to Guy Nathanzon effective 2026-08-01 and the precedent $17.5m non-cash Korea impairment come from a third, Israel Electronics News (https://techtime.news/2026/04/23/nanox-8/). NOTE: the impairment sentence also appears in the 2026-07-23 6-K exhibit that carries the pre-announced revenue used in finding 1, so findings 1 and 2 share one source document in part and should be collapsed to their largest residual, not added.

findings.finding: The baseline's reaction history is wrong in a way that matters: the -44.01% on 2026-06-25 and -24.39% on 2026-04-20 were real earnings prints (Q1 2026 and FY2025), independently confirmed as a -43.99% post-release move, so this name's actual earnings base rate is 2-for-2 double-digit declines, not a 6.52% median.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no option chain on NNOX, so no implied move and no skew exist to encode a reaction base rate at all -- the only thing standing in for 'what is priced' here is the -18.54% 20-day run-up, and the last five sessions have run the other way (+7.51%). A market that had internalised a 2-for-2 double-digit-decline earnings record on a going-concern name would not be bidding it up 22% off the 2026-09-03 low of $0.71 into the print on a regional distributor announcement.
findings.independence: FXEmpire independently records the 2026-06-25 release as an earnings report with a -43.99% price reaction and a -6.60% revenue miss, confirming it was an earnings event rather than an operational 6-K: https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/nnox/earnings

findings.finding: Offsetting and pointing the other way: the four things that caused the last two collapses are all already disclosed -- 2026 guidance withdrawn, going-concern doubt introduced, Korea restructuring announced with a $17.5m charge taken, and Q2 revenue and the $31.4m 6/30 cash balance pre-announced -- while management has run a positive-news cadence into the print (Intel/OpenVINO 8/10, UK reseller 8/18, New England distributor 9/4) and needs a shareholder majority on 2026-09-17 to lift authorized capital by 50m shares.
findings.why_not_priced: The market is treating this print as a repeat of the June 25 event; it cannot be, because the new-information content is far lower -- the revenue number and the cash number are already public and the going-concern language is already in three separate 2026 filings. A market that had recognised the pre-announcement had de-risked the print would not have taken the stock from $1.11 on 2026-08-11 to $0.71 on 2026-09-03 with no company news other than an AGM proxy. Add 8.9-13.3% of the float short and management's need for a favourable tape eight days before an authorized-capital vote, and there is a real squeeze/relief branch.
findings.independence: Short interest of 5.71m shares / 8.93% of float per stockanalysis.com (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nnox/statistics/) and the 2026-08-18 AGM proxy proposal to raise authorized capital by NIS 500,000 / 50 million shares (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795251/000121390026090993/ea030243001ex99-1.htm) are separate documents supporting the same branch.

searched_and_found_nothing: Nasdaq minimum-bid-price deficiency letter: no such 6-K or press release exists. Reconstructing the closes, NNOX last closed at or above $1.00 on 2026-08-14 ($1.00 exactly) and has closed below $1.00 continuously since 2026-08-17, so a 30-consecutive-business-day clock does not expire until roughly 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-01. Nothing for the Sept 9 window (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nnox/history/).

Reverse stock split: explicitly absent from the 2026-09-17 AGM agenda, which contains only director re-election, the NIS 500,000 authorized-capital increase, CEO equity grants, and auditor re-appointment. No special meeting has been called.

Korea subsidiary resolution: the Q1 release said sale / expanded consolidation / orderly wind-down were all under evaluation, and I found no Korean-language, Israeli-press or SEC disclosure of a decision since. This is the single largest genuinely open item and I could not source it either way.

Insider signal: the only Form 4 since the offering is CEO Erez Meltzer buying 9,443 shares at $1.03 on 2026-08-10, about $9.7k -- too small to read anything into. The 2026-08-04 Form 144 could not be fetched (SEC XSL endpoint timed out).
New 6-K or 8-K style disclosure between 2026-08-18 and 2026-09-08: none on EDGAR; the 2026-09-04 distributor release was not furnished as a 6-K.
RadNet's 2026-08-10 Q2 call as a customer read-through on ARC deployments: found no RadNet management commentary on Nanox, only Nanox's own characterisation of RadNet as a reference site.

ATM utilisation as a Q2/Q3 dilution driver: $53.9m of the $100m program remained as of 2026-07-23, but share count only moved 69,600,783 (3/31) to 78,588,638 (8/12), of which 8.0m is the registered direct -- so ATM issuance has been immaterial and is not the explanation for the August-September slide.
Nanox careers page for a headcount/team signal: nanox.vision returned HTTP 403.
App-store, support-forum and status-page angles: not applicable to a hospital capital-equipment and teleradiology business.
baseline_tension: There is no skew and no implied move to agree or disagree with -- the baseline explicitly has no priced-direction statement -- so my number rests on the two corrected earnings precedents rather than on anything the option market said; it cuts squarely against the -18.54% 20-day run-up having already done the work, because the last five sessions ran +7.51% on a small distributor announcement, and it cuts against the baseline's own 6.52% median, which mislabels a 6-K stream as prints and understates this name's true earnings reaction magnitude by roughly fourfold.
